title: Chased by a Seven-Leaf Master
summary: Wang Lin fights the six-leaf war curse master Chi Mu with a Rain Celestial Sword and the God Slaying War Chariot, and kills him even though the chariot charges slowly and the sword's demon spirit, Xu Liguo, is close to breaking. The seven-leaf curse master Mu Ye then hunts him, corners him half a month later, and plants a rune seed in his forehead that would turn him into a rune puppet. Wang Lin escapes into a space rift, gets rid of the rune with the Heaven Defying Bead, which absorbs its wood-element essence, and masters the Star Compass's teleportation to flee for months. Mu Ye chases him for four months, then destroys the only exit and tries to open a way out with the clan's Ancestor Spirit Plant.
